producer_report.summary: Moved the Landing row from gh/mod.rs into new gh/landing.rs with identical text. This covers work_branch, landed_commit, landed_commit_from_records, landed_commit_for, squash_text_for, Poll, LandPr, PrReport, land_pr, confirm_existing_merge, refusal_text, publish, and Athena::land_pr and Athena::after_merge. mod.rs declares `mod landing;` and re-exports the public names, so gh:: paths and callers are unchanged. No visibility changes were needed. The mod.rs imports are now `#[cfg(test)]` (kept for the tests left there) or dropped. The CHANGELOG G7 entry lists the moved names, import changes and a per-name caller check, and notes the early<->landing link. structure-pass.md gets a short note on that link. I ran fmt, clippy, the gh:: tests (75 pass) and the policy test. I did not run the full suite or `--list`, so the 1617 count is not confirmed.

criteria_check.criterion: A new crates/athena-core/src/gh/landing.rs holds the Landing row items (work_branch, landed_commit*, squash_text_for, Poll, LandPr, PrReport, land_pr, confirm_existing_merge, refusal_text, publish, Athena::land_pr, Athena::after_merge); git diff shows these as removed from gh/mod.rs and added to landing.rs with identical text apart from import lines and listed pub(super) visibility changes.
criteria_check.evidence: landing.rs holds all listed items with text copied verbatim from mod.rs, and mod.rs no longer has them. Only import lines differ and there are no visibility changes. I did not run a byte-for-byte diff of the moved text.

criteria_check.criterion: gh/mod.rs declares `mod landing;` and re-exports every public moved name (land_pr, LandPr, PrReport, Poll, landed_commit*, etc.), so a Grep for `gh::(land_pr|LandPr|PrReport|Poll|landed_commit)` across crates/ and xtask/ shows callers unchanged and none edited.
criteria_check.evidence: mod.rs has `mod landing;` and `pub use landing::{LandPr, Poll, PrReport, confirm_existing_merge, land_pr, landed_commit, landed_commit_for, landed_commit_from_records, squash_text_for, work_branch}`. No file outside gh/ was edited, and clippy --all-targets compiled all callers.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff changes no test function names or bodies: only `use` lines in test modules differ, and the set of #[test] fn names in the crate is unchanged (Grep count of `#[test]` before/after equal).
criteria_check.evidence: Test modules in mod.rs were not edited. The 75 gh:: tests ran with the same names as the base module (listed in the test output). I did not take a before/after #[test] count.

criteria_check.criterion: gh/landing.rs imports only from host (client), early, records, remote, pages and transport siblings as in structure-pass.md 3.1; no lower-row module imports landing except via the mod.rs re-export, and the early.rs LandPr dependency is noted in CHANGELOG.md.
criteria_check.evidence: landing.rs imports from `super` (mod.rs re-exports of client/records/remote/pages/transport items), `super::early`, and `crate::pr`. early.rs and pages.rs reach Poll/LandPr via `super` only. The CHANGELOG G7 entry and a note in structure-pass.md describe the two-way early<->landing link.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has a G7 entry that accurately lists every moved name, every visibility change and every import change kept in mod.rs, and the caller check (which files use each moved name) for each moved name.
criteria_check.evidence: The G7 entry lists moved names, 'No visibility changes', the mod.rs import changes, and per-name caller files taken from a Grep over crates/.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`; all exit 0, including every land_pr_* and early test, with the same number of tests as the recorded base run (1617).
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for the full cargo test --locked and the 1617 count. I ran fmt --check (clean), clippy (clean) and the gh:: tests (75 pass, land_pr_* and early included).

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked -- --list` and confirm the list of gh:: test names is identical to the base (git show of base is not needed: the diff touches no test names).
criteria_check.evidence: I did not run `--list`. The gh:: test names printed by `cargo test -p athena-core --locked gh::` match the unchanged test modules. Left to Athena's checks for the full list.

open_issues: LandPr still lives in landing while early.rs uses it, so early and landing depend on each other. Fixing that needs a text change, left to a later job.
mistakes: Left mod.rs imports (`Athena`, `Context`, `Serialize`) in place after the first prune, so clippy failed until I removed them.
I ran cargo fmt after the last clippy, so the final import order was never re-linted. It only reordered one import.
learnings: The tests in gh/mod.rs use `use super::*`, so every mod.rs import the moved code used had to stay under #[cfg(test)] where tests still need it.
The producer cannot sed or cat, so moving text means re-emitting it in a Write and deleting it with Edit. The 'identical text' claim was not checked mechanically.
desires: A built-in check that diffs `cargo test -- --list` before and after a move job.
